proof.surface: workflow/gate.go: dispatchArtifact now passes the parked root's own gate to recordHandover instead of skipping it. recordHandover writes the approval onto the gate (classify.ApplyDesignGateEvent, PutGate) and nothing else: no notice, no answered wait, no log line. Under gates.design off, for a stale review, or for a version older than the gate's latest, it records nothing, as applyArtifact does. So admit's keepStaleApproval, reading the gate at the re-admission the queued todo brings, finds approved >= latest and drops the pair, and ClearTreeGeneration then clears the gate. This is the person's queued approval of V, read from the gate where it is recorded: the handover's status row carries no version and is gone by the re-admission. deviations: The fix records the handover's approval on the root's own gate, the review's first option, rather than reading Dispatch at re-admission: the gate is where the person's queued approval and its version can still be read at re-admission, and the gate is cleared in the same transaction. It changes main's #2619 behaviour only in that the gate now holds the approval; #2619's two workflow assertions are updated to say so, and no notice, answered wait or log line is added.
